title.narrative: Climate induced migration and modern slavery in the Sundarbans region of Bangladesh and India

description.narrative:
CAFOD has developed an 18-month pilot initiative which aims to support research and then scale interventions which address issues of climate change and modern slavery in the Sundarbans (both in Bangladesh and India). Other parts of this project - those relating to work with Caritas Bangladesh, Baritas India and OKUP can be found in projects BAN235, 236, 237.
The project will start (this project, BAN 239) by forming a partnership with Rights Lab (University of Nottingham), a leading academic institution in the field of climate and modern slavery, to conduct a detailed assessment of the link in the Sundarbans (both in Bangladesh and India) between climate change, environmental degradation, migration and modern slavery. The findings of this study will be used to inform and refine project activities with aim to reduce the prevalence of people most affected by climate change and environmental degradation falling into modern slavery.
